voci.proprieta: metodo di soluzione e raffinamento della struttura
voci.qualitativo: direct methods; full-matrix least-squares against F2; anisotropic ADPs for non-hydrogen atoms
voci.citazione: The crystal structures were solved via direct methods and refined by a full-matrix least-squares procedure against F 2 using OLEX2 (Dolomanov et al., 2009 ▸) and SHELXTL (Sheldrick, 2008 ▸) with anisotropic displacement parameters (ADPs) for non-hydrogen atoms.
voci.note: Il testo non dice per quale cristallo vale (tutti i cinque): voce senza oggetto.

voci.qualitativo: H on N/O from the electron density map, positions and isotropic ADPs refined freely; all other H atoms in calculated positions, riding model
voci.citazione: Hydrogen atoms bonded to nitrogen or oxygen were determined by the experimental electron density map, and their isotropic displacement parameters and positions were refined freely. All other hydrogen atoms were located in geometrically calculated positions and refined using a riding model.

voci.proprieta: parametri di Flack e configurazione assoluta (testo)
voci.qualitativo: the absolute configuration of the two crystals could be determined
voci.citazione: Flack parameters for 1BER-1lTA-1W and 1BER-1dTA-1W below 0.3 were 0.05 (6) and 0.11 (4), respectively. This implies that the absolute configuration of the two crystals could be determined.
voci.note: Stessi valori della riga «Flack parameter» di Tabella 1 (voce precedente), qui con la conclusione degli autori. Incertezza: cifra fra parentesi sull'ultima cifra. «below 0.3» e' la soglia scritta dal testo.

voci.qualitativo: one BER cation and one MA anion in the asymmetric unit
voci.citazione: 1BER-1MA crystallized in the monoclinic space group P21/c with one BER cation and one MA anion in the asymmetric unit.
voci.note: Stessa frase di forme[F1].citazione; qui il fatto strutturale (Z' = una unita' formula).

voci.qualitativo: one BER cation, one MA anion, one neutral MA molecule and two water molecules in the asymmetric unit
voci.citazione: 1BER-2MA-2W crystallized in the triclinic space group P 1 with one BER cation, one MA anion, one neutral MA molecule and two water molecules in the asymmetric unit.
voci.note: Stessa frase di forme[F2].citazione.

voci.qualitativo: one BER cation, one TA anion and one water molecule in the asymmetric unit
voci.citazione: They crystallized in the triclinic space group P21 with one BER cation, one TA anion and one water molecule in the asymmetric unit.
voci.note: Frase unica per i due tartrati idrati (stessa citazione in forme[F3] e forme[F4]); «triclinic» e' in contrasto con Tabella 1 (Monoclinic), vedi `conflitto` delle forme.

voci.qualitativo: one BER cation, one TA anion and one water molecule in the asymmetric unit
voci.citazione: They crystallized in the triclinic space group P21 with one BER cation, one TA anion and one water molecule in the asymmetric unit.
voci.note: Frase unica per i due tartrati idrati (stessa citazione in forme[F3] e forme[F4]); «triclinic» e' in contrasto con Tabella 1 (Monoclinic), vedi `conflitto` delle forme.

voci.qualitativo: two BER cations and two CA anions in the asymmetric unit
voci.citazione: 2BER-2CA crystallized in the triclinic space group P 1 with two BER cations and two CA anions in the asymmetric unit.
voci.note: Stessa frase di forme[F6].citazione.

voci.proprieta: due tipi di cationi BER e di anioni CA, 2BER-2CA
voci.qualitativo: both the BER cations and the CA anions fall in two crystallographically distinct types
voci.citazione: Both BER cations and CA anions could be divided into two types in 2BER-2CA.

voci.qualitativo: C12B—C13B group of one type of BER cation disordered over two positions
voci.citazione: The C12B—C13B group in one type of BER cations is disordered over two positions with 0.53:0.47.
voci.note: Rapporto di occupazione come testo (formato e0: i rapporti vanno in `testo`).

voci.qualitativo: O11A split over two positions, in one type of CA anion
voci.citazione: The disordered O11A is split over two positions with 0.54:0.46, also observed in one type of the CA anions.
voci.note: Rapporto di occupazione come testo.

voci.proprieta: protonazione degli acidi e classificazione come sali
voci.qualitativo: the acid loses a proton in each crystal; the samples are termed salts
voci.citazione: Loss of a proton derived from the acid occurred in each crystal. Hence, these samples were termed salts.

voci.qualitativo: an additional neutral MA molecule is included: salt cocrystal
voci.citazione: However, an additional neutral MA molecule was also included in 1BER-2MA-2W, which can be classified as a salt cocrystal.

voci.qualitativo: layers held by van der Waals forces; MA anions scattered in the voids of the 3D structure
voci.citazione: The layer-like structures depend on van der Waals forces to create a three-dimensional structure with MA anions scattered in the voids

voci.qualitativo: chains and layers assembled into a 3D structure with alternating hydrophobic and hydrophilic zones
voci.citazione: Ultimately, the chain-like structures and layer-like structures that rely on van der Waals forces were assembled into a three-dimensional structure with hydro­phobic zones and hydro­philic zones in an alternate arrangement

voci.qualitativo: layers assembled via van der Waals forces; hydrophilic chains scattered in the voids
voci.citazione: The layer-like structures assemble via van der Waals forces into a three-dimensional structure with hydro­philic chain-like structures scattered in the voids
voci.note: Frase unica per i due tartrati idrati (Fig. 6a e 6b).

voci.qualitativo: layers assembled via van der Waals forces; hydrophilic chains scattered in the voids
voci.citazione: The layer-like structures assemble via van der Waals forces into a three-dimensional structure with hydro­philic chain-like structures scattered in the voids
voci.note: Frase unica per i due tartrati idrati (Fig. 6a e 6b).

voci.qualitativo: 3D structure with hydrophilic chains scattered in the voids, assembled by layers (as in the tartrates)
voci.citazione: Similar to 1BER-1LTA-1W and 1BER-1DTA-1W, a three-dimensional structure with hydro­philic chain-like structures scattered in the voids assembled by the layer-like structures were formed

voci.proprieta: quasi isostrutturalita' dei due tartrati idrati
voci.qualitativo: 1BER-1lTA-1W and 1BER-1dTA-1W have similar cell parameters and crystal structure; almost the same PXRD pattern, FT-IR spectra and TGA/DSC curves expected
voci.citazione: However, the products obtained with 1BER-1lTA-1W and 1BER-1dTA-1W have similar cell parameters and crystal structure. This indicates that the two samples would have almost the same PXRD pattern, FT-IR spectra and TGA/DSC curves.
voci.note: L'attribuzione ad entrambe le forme F3 e F4: oggetto non unico.

voci.proprieta: assi a e b di 1BER-1MA a 100 e 293 K (testo)
voci.qualitativo: a and b axes lengthen from 100 to 293 K; c axis almost unchanged
voci.citazione: The 6.844 (1) Å a axis and 19.545 (1) Å b axis at 100 K increased to 6.943 (1) Å and 19.818 (2) Å at 293 K, respectively, whereas the c axis showed almost no change.
voci.note: Stessi valori della Tabella 1 (colonne 1BER-1MA e 1BER-1MA-1) e della frase usata come citazione di forme[F1]; qui con l'osservazione sull'asse c. Incertezza: cifra fra parentesi sull'ultima cifra. Non e' un evento (stessa forma, stesso gruppo).

voci.proprieta: effetto della T sulle posizioni dei picchi, 1BER-1MA (100 K contro 293 K)
voci.qualitativo: simulated pattern at 100 K and experimental pattern at 293 K would have different peak positions
voci.citazione: This implies that the peak positions of 1BER-1MA between the simulated PXRD pattern based on SCXRD data at 100 K and the experimental PXRD pattern collected at 293 K would be different.

voci.proprieta: accordo fra picchi sperimentali (293 K) e calcolati (100 K), quattro forme
voci.qualitativo: experimental (293 K) and calculated (100 K) peak positions essentially consistent: no obvious change of the cell between 100 and 293 K
voci.citazione: The experimental peak positions of 1BER-2MA-2W, 1BER-1lTA-1W, 1BER-1dTA-1W and 2BER-2CA were essentially consistent with the calculated peak positions derived from the SCXRD data collected at 100 K. This suggests that there are no obvious differences in the unit-cell parameters of these crystals between 100 and 293 K.
voci.note: Quattro forme (F2, F3, F4, F6): oggetto non unico.

voci.proprieta: 1BER-1MA: a e b piu' corti a 100 K, picchi diversi
voci.qualitativo: a and b axes notably shortened at 100 K relative to 293 K; some peak positions differ
voci.citazione: However, the a and b axes of 1BER-1MA at 100 K relative to 293 K were notably shortened, which caused some peak positions at 100 K to differ from those at 293 K.

voci.proprieta: ripresa nelle conclusioni: cella di 1BER-1MA sensibile alla temperatura
voci.qualitativo: cell of 1BER-1MA sensitive to temperature; calculated peak positions at 100 K clearly differ from those at 293 K
voci.citazione: The unit-cell parameters of 1BER-1MA were sensitive to temperature. Subsequently, the calculated characteristic diffraction peak positions of 1BER-1MA at 100 K clearly differ from those at 293 K.
voci.note: Ripresa nelle Conclusioni degli stessi fatti delle voci precedenti.

voci.proprieta: PXRD: tensione e corrente del tubo, temperatura della misura
voci.citazione: PXRD experiments were performed on a Rigaku D/max-2550 diffractometer with Cu Kα radiation (Rigaku, Tokyo, Japan) at 40 kV and 150 mA at 293 K.

voci.citazione: The peak position, number and shape in the regions 3200–3800 cm−1 and 1700–1800 cm−1 attributed to the characteristic OH and C=O absorptions were remarkably different among the samples obtained due to the distinct hydrogen interactions (Fig. S12), with the exception of 1BER-1lTA-1W and 1BER-1dTA-1W.

voci.proprieta: contributi principali alle superfici di Hirshfeld
voci.qualitativo: O⋯H, C⋯H, H⋯H and C⋯C contacts contribute significantly
voci.citazione: It is clear that the O⋯H, C⋯H, H⋯H and C⋯C interactions contribute significantly to the Hirshfeld surfaces.

An increasing proportion of the strong O⋯H interactions – with 46.4% in 1BER-2MA-W – was observed because two water molecules and one additional MA molecule are incorporated into the crystal structure compared with 36.4% in 1BER-1MA, and there is no obvious difference in packing coefficient between 1BER-1MA and 1BER-2MA-2W.
voci.note: Il testo scrive «1BER-2MA-W» per 1BER-2MA-2W. Percentuali della superficie di Hirshfeld (Fig. 8).

voci.proprieta: implicazione della proporzione O⋯H sulla formazione di 1BER-2MA-2W
voci.qualitativo: stronger connection between molecules in 1BER-2MA-2W; its formation over 1BER-1MA is favoured when the water content and the MA:BER ratio increase
voci.citazione: This implies a stronger connection between the molecules in 1BER-2MA-2W. Thus, it is favourable for the formation of 1BER-2MA-2W over 1BER-1MA when the water content in solution and molar ratio of MA to BER increase to a certain extent.
voci.note: Interpretazione degli autori sulla preparazione (vedi le preparazioni di F1 e F2).

voci.proprieta: MAS in acqua pura: effetto dell'affinita' del controione per l'acqua
voci.qualitativo: MAS of the salts markedly affected by the affinity of the counter-ion to water; malonate the most soluble
voci.citazione: It is obvious that the MAS of the novel salts was markedly affected by the affinity of the counter-ion to water. Among these organic acids, MA exhibits the best solubility. Therefore, the MAS of BER malonate was significantly higher than that of the other BER salts.
voci.note: Le MAS numeriche sono nelle `molecole`.

voci.proprieta: 1BER-1MA contro 1BER-2MA-2W: stesso controione, impacchettamento simile, diversa solubilita'
voci.qualitativo: 1BER-1MA more soluble than 1BER-2MA-2W, attributed ("may be") to the lower proportion of O⋯H contacts
voci.citazione: In addition, 1BER-1MA and 1BER-2MA-2W included the same type of counter-ion as malonic acid and had similar packing indexes, but the former displayed better solubility, which may be attributed to the weaker intermolecular interactions with a lower proportion of O⋯H interactions (36.4%) compared with 1BER-2MA-2W (46.4%).
voci.note: Stessi valori della voce sui contatti di Hirshfeld; qui l'interpretazione sulla solubilita' (dubitativa: «may be attributed»). Percentuali di Hirshfeld, quindi calcolato.

voci.proprieta: effetto della chiralita' dell'acido tartarico sulla MAS e regola di Wallach
voci.qualitativo: chirality of TA affects the MAS; accordance with Wallach's rule (racemic crystals denser than chiral ones)
voci.citazione: In particular, the effect of chirality of TA on the MAS of the final products was clearly related to their solubilities. This phenomenon was in accordance with Wallach’s rule (Brock et al., 1991 ▸; Wang et al., 2012 ▸) which states that racemic crystals have a higher density relative to their chiral counterparts.
voci.note: Regola citata da Brock et al., 1991 e Wang et al., 2012.

voci.proprieta: 2BER-2CA contro i tartrati: coefficiente di impacchettamento e MAS
voci.qualitativo: MAS of 2BER-2CA significantly improved over the tartrates, attributed to its smaller packing coefficient
voci.citazione: Solubility of CA was slightly greater than that of dTA/lTA. However, significant improvement in the MAS for 2BER-2CA was achieved compared with 1BER-1lTA-1W and 1BER-1dTA-1W, which resulted from a smaller packing coefficient of 2BER-2CA with 69.6% relative to that of 1BER-1lTA-1W with 75.3% and 1BER-1dTA-1W with 75.6%.
voci.note: Stessi valori della voce sui coefficienti di impacchettamento.

voci.citazione: In particular, the MAS of 1BER-1MA in dilute hydro­chloric solution is as high as 34 times that of the commercial form.
voci.note: Incoerenza dell'articolo: l'abstract dice 34 volte, il testo dei risultati «33-fold» (voce successiva). Dai valori scritti (68.8 e 2.1 µmol/ml) il rapporto e' circa 32.8 (conto di controllo mio, non un numero scritto).

voci.qualitativo: order of MAS in HCl as in pure water except 1BER-1HCl-M (lowest, possibly common ion effect); all novel forms notably higher than the commercial form
voci.citazione: The MAS order in dilute hydro­chloric solution for the samples was in agreement with that in pure water, except for 1BER-1HCl-M with the lowest MAS, which may be the result of the common ion effect. The MAS of all the samples obtained was notably higher than that of the commercial form (1BER-1HCl-M), especially 1BER-1MA with a 33-fold increase.
voci.note: Vedi l'incoerenza 34 contro 33 nella voce dell'abstract. Unita' «-fold» come scritta («33-fold increase»).

voci.proprieta: aumento di MAS in acqua pura rispetto alla forma commerciale: conclusioni
voci.citazione: The MAS values of BER-1MA and 1BER-2MA-2W in pure water, which show an increase of 23- and 6-fold, respectively, are obviously superior to that of the commercial form of BER.
voci.note: Il testo scrive «BER-1MA» per 1BER-1MA. I rapporti non sono ripetuti nei risultati (ricavabili dalle MAS in acqua, 149.5/6.5 e 41.9/6.5: conto di controllo mio).

voci.proprieta: effetto dello ione comune escluso come causa della minore MAS di 1BER-2MA-2W
voci.qualitativo: common ion effect not the cause of the lower MAS of 1BER-2MA-2W compared with 1BER-1MA
voci.citazione: Hence, the common ion effect was not the cause of the lower MAS of 1BER-2MA-2W compared with 1BER-1MA.
voci.note: La frase precedente del testo («1BER-2MA-2W did not convert to 1BER-1MA in pure water») e' una citazione dell'evento negativo in sospensione.

voci.proprieta: solubilita' apparenti a 48 h piu' alte di quella di 1BER-1HCl-4W da 1BER-1HCl-M
voci.qualitativo: final apparent solubilities after conversion to 1BER-1HCl-4W are different from each other and significantly greater than that of 1BER-1HCl-4W derived from 1BER-1HCl-M
voci.citazione: Note that all the investigated salts underwent transformation to 1BER-1HCl-4W, but their final apparent solubilities were different and significantly greater than that of 1BER-1HCl-4W derived from 1BER-1HCl-M.
voci.note: Valori a 48 h nelle `molecole`. Incoerenza: per 1BER-1dl-TA la solubilita' apparente a 48 h (5.1 µmol/ml) e' maggiore della MAS in acido cloridrico (4.5 µmol/ml), mentre il testo dice che i valori a 48 h sono «below their MAS».

voci.citazione: This signifies that there may be a positive correlation between the conversion rate and the MAS of the distinct salts.
